```{python setup}
 
import _common 
# Get pubs from Google sheet
csv_url_scopus= 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WSYrtnDG0PtIkMdG69PH11_vFk4fSf3X6TITkuK7v0w/export?format=csv&gid=373027543'
pubs = _common.get_pubs(csv_url_scopus)
 
# Generate HTML for the specified category
html_output_articles = _common.make_pub_list(pubs, "Article")
html_output_conferences = _common.make_pub_list(pubs, "Conference paper")


# Generate HTML for working papers and under review
csv_url_working= 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WSYrtnDG0PtIkMdG69PH11_vFk4fSf3X6TITkuK7v0w/export?format=csv&gid=2098666656'
pubs_working = _common.get_pubs(csv_url_working)

html_output_working = _common.make_pub_working(pubs_working)

```
